description: This file contains unit test functions for the Controller component of the orchestrator package. It tests various HTTP endpoint handlers such as creating and retrieving CVDs, operations, user artifacts, and debug variables.

methods.name: TestCreateCVDIsHandled
methods.description: Tests that the POST /cvds endpoint is handled correctly.

methods.name: TestGetCVDLogsIsHandled
methods.description: Tests that the GET /cvds/cvd-1/logs endpoint is handled correctly.

methods.name: TestGetOperationIsHandled
methods.description: Tests that the GET /operations/foo endpoint is handled correctly.

methods.name: TestGetOperationsIsHandled
methods.description: Tests that the GET /operations endpoint is handled correctly.

methods.name: TestGetOperationResultIsHandled
methods.description: Tests that the GET /operations/{op}/result endpoint is handled correctly.

methods.name: TestWaitOperationIsHandled
methods.description: Tests that the POST /operations/{op}/:wait endpoint is handled correctly.

methods.name: TestWaitOperationNotFound
methods.description: Tests handling of waiting for a non-existent operation.

methods.name: TestWaitOperationTimeout
methods.description: Tests wait operation behavior with timeout.

methods.name: TestWaitOperationOperationIsDone
methods.description: Tests that waiting on a completed operation returns OK.

methods.name: TestCreateUploadDirectoryIsHandled
methods.description: Tests handling of creating a new user artifact upload directory.

methods.name: TestUploadUserArtifactIsHandled
methods.description: Tests uploading a user artifact via multipart form data.
